install.title: Enable local BowPane pairing
install.description: Enable the local companion, then start pairing on your TV or test Mac agent. Add another BowPane integration entry to enter the code and approve its role. No cloud pairing service or Home Assistant access token is required.

user.title: Pair BowPane
user.description: Enter the code shown on your device and approve its role. Mac agents receive read-only module health; leave TV display settings closed. For a TV, expand those settings and select one to four cameras. Finish by confirming on the device. Remove this integration entry to revoke new API access. Existing video streams expire through Home Assistant.

tv_settings.name: TV display settings
tv_settings.description: For a TV only: select one to four cameras and optional sensors or weather.

data.show_weather: Show weather beneath the Glance clock (Free and Pro)

error.invalid_pairing: Check the code, its five-minute expiry, the device role, and your selected entities. TV pairing requires one to four cameras; Mac agents need none. When weather is enabled for a TV, select an existing weather entity and an optional temperature sensor. A code can be used only once. After five incorrect attempts, wait five minutes.

abort.admin_required: A Home Assistant administrator must approve pairing.

init.title: Edit TV cameras, sensors and display

data_description.show_weather: Current conditions and outside temperature, plus optional indoor temperature. Does not use any of the four custom sensor slots. Select a primary weather entity when enabled.
data_description.crop_to_fill: Off: fit the whole image without distortion (borders may appear). On: fill each camera tile by cropping the edges. Applies to Glance, Camera Grid and full-screen cameras.
data_description.edge_to_edge: Uses more of the TV screen with a small focus margin. Turn off if your television clips the edges. Applies to Glance, Camera Grid and Home Panel; available in Free and Pro.
data_description.default_view: Used on next app launch. Home Panel requires Pro; otherwise Glance opens. Does not change your current view.

init.description:
{access_status}
Changes appear within about 30 seconds. No new pairing code is needed. Home Panel is a Pro read-only preview: select up to six distinct sensors in numbered display order, left to right. Clear optional selections to remove them. Tier reports control this form only; the TV enforces access locally.

data.grid_clock: Show clock in Camera Grid and full-screen camera
data.show_weather: Show weather beneath the Glance clock (Free and Pro)
data.edge_to_edge: Screen margins: use expanded view (reduce overscan border)
data.name: TV name

error.invalid_selection: Select existing entities: one to four cameras, up to four Glance sensors, and up to six distinct Home Panel sensors. When weather is enabled, select a weather entity and an optional sensor with temperature device class.

abort.select_tv: Choose Configure on your paired TV entry, not the pairing service entry.
abort.agent_scope_fixed: This prototype agent has a fixed read-only health scope. Remove its integration entry to revoke access.
